title: Retrieval Modules and Utilities
summary: This module provides various retrieval mechanisms, including local and remote ColBERTv2, Databricks Vector Search, and Weaviate, to fetch relevant passages for a given query. It also includes a generic retrieval interface and utilities for text processing and result formatting.

nodes.label: Generic Document Retrieval
nodes.title: dspy.retrievers.retrieve.Retrieve
nodes.description: Provides a standardized interface for retrieving documents based on a query, delegating to the configured Retrieval Model (RM).

nodes.label: Retrieve from Databricks Vector Search
nodes.title: dspy.retrievers.databricks_rm.DatabricksRM
nodes.description: Connects to and queries a Databricks Mosaic AI Vector Search Index to fetch relevant documents.

nodes.label: Retrieve from Weaviate
nodes.title: dspy.retrievers.weaviate_rm.WeaviateRM
nodes.description: Interacts with a Weaviate collection to find and return top passages for a given query.

nodes.label: Query Remote ColBERTv2 Service
nodes.title: dspy.dsp.colbertv2.ColBERTv2
nodes.description: Communicates with a remote ColBERTv2 endpoint to perform document retrieval using GET or POST requests.

nodes.label: Manage Local ColBERTv2 Index
nodes.title: dspy.dsp.colbertv2.ColBERTv2RetrieverLocal
nodes.description: Builds, loads, and searches a local ColBERTv2 index from a collection of passages for efficient retrieval.

nodes.label: Rerank Passages Locally (ColBERTv2)
nodes.title: dspy.dsp.colbertv2.ColBERTv2RerankerLocal
nodes.description: Reranks a list of passages based on a query using a local ColBERTv2 model to improve relevance.

nodes.label: Retrieve Embeddings with Scores
nodes.title: dspy.retrievers.embeddings.EmbeddingsWithScores
nodes.description: Extends basic embedding retrieval to also return similarity scores alongside passages and indices, enabling more nuanced results.

nodes.label: DSPy Global Configuration
nodes.title: dspy.dsp.utils.settings.Settings
nodes.description: Manages global DSPy settings, including the currently active Retrieval Model (RM), which dictates the default retrieval behavior.

nodes.label: Tokenize Text for DPR
nodes.title: dspy.dsp.utils.dpr.SimpleTokenizer
nodes.description: A basic tokenizer used for processing text, particularly in the context of Dense Passage Retrieval (DPR) and related models.

nodes.label: Locate Answers in Text
nodes.title: dspy.dsp.utils.dpr.locate_answers
nodes.description: Identifies and returns character offsets for occurrences of answers within a given tokenized text.

nodes.label: Load Batch Backgrounds
nodes.title: dspy.dsp.utils.utils.load_batch_backgrounds
nodes.description: Utility function to load background passages for a batch of queries, often used in specific DSP processing contexts.

nodes.label: Wrap ColBERTv2 GET Request
nodes.title: dspy.dsp.colbertv2.colbertv2_get_request_v2_wrapped
nodes.description: A wrapper function for making GET requests to a ColBERTv2 service, simplifying API interaction.

nodes.label: Wrap ColBERTv2 POST Request
nodes.title: dspy.dsp.colbertv2.colbertv2_post_request_v2_wrapped
nodes.description: A wrapper function for making POST requests to a ColBERTv2 service, facilitating data submission.

nodes.label: Format Single Query Passages
nodes.title: dspy.retrievers.retrieve.single_query_passage
nodes.description: Transforms a list of passage dictionaries into a standardized DSPy Prediction object for consistent output.

nodes.label: User Query
nodes.title: User Input
nodes.description: The input query provided by the user or another module for document retrieval.

nodes.label: Retrieved Documents
nodes.title: Retrieval Results
nodes.description: The output collection of relevant documents, passages, or embeddings returned by a retriever, potentially with scores.

nodes.label: Databricks Vector Search Index
nodes.title: External Databricks Index
nodes.description: An external Databricks service storing vector embeddings and metadata for efficient search.

nodes.label: Weaviate Collection
nodes.title: External Weaviate Database
nodes.description: An external Weaviate database or collection used for vector search and document storage.

nodes.label: Local ColBERTv2 Index
nodes.title: Local ColBERTv2 Data
nodes.description: A locally managed index for ColBERTv2 retrieval, built from a collection of passages.

nodes.label: Remote ColBERTv2 Service
nodes.title: External ColBERTv2 API
nodes.description: An external service hosting a ColBERTv2 model, providing retrieval capabilities via an API.

groups.label: Surface API
groups.title: User-Facing Retrieval Interface
groups.description: Components that provide the primary interface for users to perform document retrieval.

groups.label: Data Retrievers
groups.title: Specific Retrieval Model Implementations
groups.description: Components that implement specific retrieval logic, interacting with various data sources or services.

groups.label: Analytical Components
groups.title: Reranking and Scored Retrieval
groups.description: Components focused on enhancing retrieval results through reranking or providing additional analytical data like scores.

groups.label: Utility Functions
groups.title: Helper Functions and Wrappers
groups.description: Miscellaneous helper functions and wrappers that support the core retrieval logic or provide text processing capabilities.
